ghostHunt.name: ghostHunt
ghostHunt.justification: No duration from 240 to 1200 satisfied the design rule; the provisional ghostHuntTicks = 480 is kept unchanged. The Squareman win-rate floor 0.15 was not met at any duration (max 0): the automated policy wins the contested race almost always, so this metric is saturated and cannot rank durations. Reference only, not used to choose: humanCasual Squareman win rate 0 to 0.

bombRadius.name: bombRadius
bombRadius.justification: Largest radius (most useful to the Player) with mean walls per Bomb <= 10 (8.2814) and median ratio shift <= 0.15 (0.1075) versus bombNone.

bombs.name: bombs
bombs.justification: No combination satisfied the design rule; the provisional bombsPerLevel = 3 and bombFairnessDelta = 3 are kept unchanged. bombAggressive wins above the 0.9 ceiling at every point (min 0.995): the automated Player wins the contested race almost always, so the win-rate criterion is saturated and cannot rank the Bomb parameters.

wisps.name: wisps
wisps.justification: Pellet-clear median exceeds the threeKey rescue median by >= 0.1 (4.1298) and coverage holds for >= 0.999 of Seeds (1); among qualifying densities the highest one with a wispSweep slowdown <= 0.1, else the smallest slowdown (0.0958).

override.deviatesFrom: highest qualifying density with a wispSweep slowdown <= 0.1
override.reason: The user wants the Player to have plenty of meaningful collectibles. 0.5 still passes the race margin (3.665 vs the 0.1 floor) and coverage (100%); only the wispSweep slowdown criterion (0.179 vs 0.1) is exceeded, and that metric comes from a bot that ignores Keys.

combo.name: combo
combo.justification: No window gives a median best Combo strictly between 1 and the cap; kept 120.
combo.capJustification: Inconclusive: no cap from 5 to 15 gives a median best Combo strictly between 1 and the cap (the median reaches the cap every time); kept comboCap = 5.
